name: mafia-tax-audit-click
description: Issue #1409: the player picks a smuggling volume with a real click in the Shady panel; the tax office eventually audits and, with nothing smuggled, finds everything in order. Smuggling has no per-tick exposure any more, so the run stays unarrested.

steps.description: role: bootstrap (issue #515): the cost:X override is a scenario-only convenience; ShadyPanel's real bribe button uses the fixed TARGET_COSTS rate. Bribes are only here to unlock the mafia section; a failed bribe also costs a fine, so cash is asserted by direction.
